_readme: The log, newest first. `date` is YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. `kind`: shipped | note | elsewhere | milestone. `href` is optional (a /notes/ path or a full URL). Dated, checkable facts only; no sales numbers.

entries.text: Printed the first copy of this site.
Turned my store’s order dashboard into a phone app that rings when someone orders.
Wrote twenty new guides, picked from what people in India actually search, Hinglish included.
Built an AI help desk on Gemini. It answers from real facts and hands people to WhatsApp when it can’t.
Cut a checkout down to seven fields, after reading the research on why people give up on carts.
Moved my store from Vercel to Cloudflare Workers. Parts of it quietly broke for two weeks. The build checks itself before every deploy now.
Wrote down why I started my first product.
